_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for closed-loop-psrr on the `klt sim` harness (issue #415, part of #412). Mechanics: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py; argument: this file.
Claim: Closed-loop power-supply rejection of the assembled schematic bandgap (bandgap_core trim-bearing at trim_code=128 + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup, wired as design/bandgap_top.sch, loop closed) across the full PVT grid: a 1 V/0 deg AC perturbation on vdd, PSRR = -db(v(vref)), the operating point nodeset-seeded from sim/closed-loop-startup's committed record (125 C row per corner/supply baked, with the enrichment pass checking the landed op against the per-temperature reference from that same record with the legacy bench's 50 mV tolerance, plus startup-released / loop-closed / not-railed). Evidence only: NOT compared against a ratified spec row as a pass/fail verdict (see the experiment README).
Netlist provenance: design/netlist/bandgap_core.spice (trim-bearing, trim_code=128), design/netlist/bandgap_amp.spice and design/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, carried verbatim into sim/closed-loop-psrr/testbench/closed_loop_psrr.body.spice.tmpl (XMSENSE w= read from the live startup netlist).
PDK: `ihp-sg13g2` -- pinned release in sim/pdk.json; OSDI models built by sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (local) / baked into the batch runner image (#277).
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
